mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y GDPC1 growth accelerates by >1pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 50, indicating a contraction in manufacturing activity, it predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the slowing industrial sector weighs on the broader economy.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 50 but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate, defined as a 0.5pp rise over 3 months, signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will pressure consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (proxied by HOUST) rise by more than 10% year-over-year, it signals a strengthening housing market that will boost consumer spending and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y HOUST growth > 10% but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and payroll employment (PAYEMS) both decline simultaneously over a 3-month period, it signals a tightening labor market that will boost wage growth and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE and PAYEMS both decline over 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) rises by more than 3% year-over-year, signaling high inflation, and the federal funds rate is above 2%, indicating that monetary policy is not accommodative, it predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as high inflation and tight monetary policy weigh on economic growth.
failure_condition: Y/Y CPIAUCSL > 3% and FEDFUNDS > 2% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) is in a year-over-year decline and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 6%, it signals a recessionary environment that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y GDPC1 decline and UNRATE > 6% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >40% of instances.
